metadata.description: An opinionated Claude Code workflow + knowledge harness in two editions — un-themed (harness-core) and full Spider-Man (friendly-neighborhood). Install one.

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: An opinionated workflow + knowledge harness with four structural differentiators: (1) three-tier work model — objective (long-lived why, Key Results, milestones, decisions log) → workstream (heavy QRDBIV lifecycle, multi-session) → assignment (lightweight unit, proportional admin); (2) progressive distillation — research broadly, then compress at every handoff to the fewest, most precise words (semantic density: dense meaning per token via careful word choice, not just fewer tokens), keeping the decisions reached and dropping the back-and-forth that reached them, proportional to work size and targeted at the next phase's needs; (3) peer-reviewed knowledge pipeline — scout → harvest → distill → cartograph → audit → sync, vault grows only by admission, nothing rewrites itself unsupervised; (4) a deterministic verification gate (tools/gate.py, GO/NO-GO exit code) for hard measurable concerns, leaving soft judgments qualitative and recorded; plus determinism for the repeatable — any assignment done twice becomes a CLI. No agent personas, no theme — just the capabilities.

plugins.name: friendly-neighborhood
plugins.description: An opinionated Claude Code harness for serious, long-horizon work, re-themed Spider-Man. Three tiers of work (responsibility → campaign → mission), a peer-reviewed knowledge-vault pipeline, progressive distillation at every handoff, and a decision mechanic that splits hard signals (a deterministic gate) from soft ones (affirmative villain dissent). Plus a Spider-cast of agents, the symbiote (disciplined, turn-limited model escalation), a live per-character observation deck, and native autonomous looping. Cheap by default; ceremony scaled to the work.
